usage.title: Using Sovia Resources
usage.description: Rules and common examples for character fan works, cosplay photos and music.
usage.intro: Find common uses by resource type. Character fan works and music owned by Sovia are open; works based on other songs may still involve rights in the original.

items.title: What can I make?
items.text: For materials Sovia explicitly makes available for open use, you can create, publish and sell derivative works. Handmade work and AI are equally welcome.

items.title: Do I need permission or source files?
items.text: No individual application to Sovia is needed for those materials, and you do not have to share source files.

items.title: What are the boundaries?
items.text: Do not impersonate the creator or official project, or imply official endorsement. Photographs of real people, third-party works and independent original characters follow their own rules.

items.title: Must I let others reuse my derivative work?
items.text: We encourage it, but it is not currently mandatory. Others may use your contribution within the permissions you explicitly grant.

visuals.title: Character fan works
visuals.description: For character designs that the Sovia project has the right to license and explicitly makes available for open use, you may create, publish and use derivative works commercially without individual approval. Do not impersonate the original creator or the official project, or imply official endorsement. Third-party materials, independent original characters and photographs of real people follow their own rules.
allowed: Draw fan art, write fiction or comics, and make animation or videos.
Cosplay the characters and make your own costumes, props or 3D fan works.
Make and sell your own fan merchandise without asking first.
Share your fan works on social media, in portfolios or at events.
prohibited: Impersonating the creator of the characters or Comrade Sovia project.
Publishing through an account or identity that falsely presents you as the official creator.

cosplay.title: Cosplay photos
cosplay.description: These rules apply to photos in this site’s cosplay gallery.
allowed: Download and save them for a personal collection or wallpaper.
Repost them on social platforms or share the photos and original post links.
Crop, resize or lay them out for display without distorting their original expression.
Add a short caption such as “Cute” or a character line that preserves the original meaning.
prohibited: Changing the person’s clothing with image editing or AI.
Demeaning the person or maliciously altering their face, body or expression.
Fabricating what the person said, believed or did to misrepresent the photo.
Other misleading edits that depart from the photo’s original expression.

songs.title: Songs and lyrics
songs.description: Sovia does not require individual approval for its own recordings, arrangements and original lyrics. Rights in an underlying song still need separate consideration.

types.title: Adaptations of other songs
types.description: Songs covered, rearranged or reinterpreted by Sovia.
allowed: Download, save and repost Sovia’s released version without Sovia’s permission.
Use Sovia’s recording unchanged in a video or stream without Sovia’s permission.
Record and publish your own cover of Sovia’s version without Sovia’s permission.
Remix, sample or rearrange Sovia’s recording without Sovia’s permission.
notes: For covers or releases, check the original song’s composition, lyrics, recording rights and platform rules.
Changing the original melody or lyrics may require permission from the original rightsholders for an adaptation.

types.title: Adapted lyrics written by Sovia
types.description: This permission covers the lyrics Sovia wrote, not an underlying melody owned by someone else.
allowed: Copy, quote or share lyrics written by Sovia.
Sing or record those lyrics, or use them in subtitles and videos.
Translate, revise or build on those lyrics, including in commercial works.
notes: If you also use the original melody, original lyrics or other protected elements, check the rights in those elements.
Releasing new lyrics set to an original song’s melody may still require the original rightsholder’s permission.

types.title: Original songs by Sovia
types.description: Songs whose music and lyrics are original to Sovia are open for use and reinterpretation.
allowed: Cover or rerecord them, or arrange them in a different style.
Rewrite lyrics, remix, sample or make other derivative works.
Download, repost or use them as music in videos, streams or games.
Release or sell your own version without asking Sovia.
